uncovered_item_details.scientific_object: Four feedback/post-selection simulation curves for two states with and without correction
direct_gap_statements: The disclosed p_X=p_Y=p_Z=rp/3 injection mechanism is reproduced exactly, but the paper-exact Fig. 2(c) dashed curves additionally require the circuit-level gate and measurement error model that the publication does not provide.

direct_cause.statement: The disclosed p_X=p_Y=p_Z=rp/3 injection mechanism is reproduced exactly, but the paper-exact Fig. 2(c) dashed curves additionally require the circuit-level gate and measurement error model that the publication does not provide.

root_cause.statement: The main text states that Fig. 2(c) uses gate and measurement errors, while the supplement publishes only aggregate processor statistics rather than the location-resolved channels, correlations, composition rule, and calibration snapshot needed to reconstruct those curves uniquely.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No defect was found in the independently implemented disclosed mechanism: a closed form and exhaustive 4^3 Pauli enumeration agree to 2e-15, focused tests pass, and the isolated run binds the generated feedback curves.

checks.statement: The analytic feedback expression agrees with exhaustive enumeration of all 64 injected Pauli patterns to machine precision.
The source audit separates the printed p=8.8%, rp/3 injection law and 64 circuits from the unpublished circuit-level gate and measurement model.
The main article and Supplementary Note 3/Table 1 were audited directly; they contain aggregate calibration summaries but not the indispensable simulator input deck.
The isolated logical-QEM run returned zero and froze the T001 feedback curves without forbidden scientific inputs.

next_discriminating_test.action: Obtain the circuit-location-resolved gate, preparation, readout, correlation, and calibration contracts used by the Fig. 2(c) simulator, then rerun the existing clean-room implementation.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: The supplied input deck either reproduces the dashed curves or exposes a genuine scientific discrepancy under a fixed model.

next_discriminating_actions: Obtain the circuit-location-resolved gate, preparation, readout, correlation, and calibration contracts used by the Fig. 2(c) simulator, then rerun the existing clean-room implementation.

next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: A complete contract either makes the panel reproducible or confirms the publication boundary as terminal.
